QuestInfo.name: After Centuries 3
QuestInfo.0: Your battle with the Black Mage feels like it happened yesterday, but today people don't even remember that Elves existed. It can't be. Maybe this is all a trick of the Black Mage's! Ask #bArwen#k for help.
QuestInfo.1: #p1032100# says you don't look so good. She suggests visiting #b#p1032101##k if you're sick. Rowen's healing magic is supposed to be strong, but you still can't believe what Arwen's saying. Ask Rowen about this era for now.
QuestInfo.2: You really were asleep for hundreds of years. But why were you the only Elf to awaken?

0.0: Wow, you really DON'T look good! Your face is clammy, and you're sweating. Look, why don't you go see #b#p1032101##k? Rowen's healing magic is the best. She'll fix you right up.

0.msg: #b(The shock is just too great. Has it really been centuries? Have the Elves really been forgotten? It must be some mistake. Ask #p1032101# what she knows about Elves.)#k

no.0: Really? Well, just don't die over here, then. Shoo!

1.0: My, you don't look well! Would you like a healing potion? ...What's this about Elves?

yes.0: Let's see. I read about the Elves in a book long ago. They're supposed to be this long lost race of Fairies, but there are only two races alive today: The Sylphs of Ellinia, and the Nymphs of Orbis.

default.0: Go on. #b#p1032101##k is right over there.
